before_action.text: 左侧开胸标记和肋间进入点已经核对，先保护胸壁的神经血管束。
before_action.text_en: The left thoracotomy markings and intercostal entry point are confirmed. Protect the chest-wall neurovascular bundle.

before_action.text: 开胸器械、肋间牵开器和长吸引，准备进入。
before_action.text_en: Thoracotomy instruments, a rib spreader, and long suction are ready.

after_resolution.text: 胸腔进入完成，我维持肺组织向前牵开，给降主动脉留出视野。
after_resolution.text_en: The chest is open. I'll retract the lung anteriorly to expose the descending aorta.

after_resolution.text: 右侧卧位的受压点和通气条件我会持续复核。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll continue checking pressure points and ventilation conditions in the right lateral position.

before_action.text: 主动脉瘤壁不能当牵拉点，先从邻近正常组织判断边界。
before_action.text_en: The aneurysm wall must not become a traction point. Define its margins from adjacent normal tissue.

before_action.text: 湿纱布、长无创牵开片和深部吸引已经换好。
before_action.text_en: Moist pads, long atraumatic retractors, and deep suction are ready.

after_resolution.text: 近远端正常血管与邻近组织的关系有了，下一步再去找可控制区。
after_resolution.text_en: The proximal and distal normal aorta and nearby structures are defined. Next we identify control zones.

before_action.text: 近端控制区要离开脆弱瘤壁，远端也不能为了够到就硬拉主动脉。
before_action.text_en: The proximal control zone must be away from the fragile aneurysm wall. Do not pull on the aorta to reach the distal zone.

before_action.text: 血管环、长直角钳和精细血管剪。
before_action.text_en: Vessel loops, a long right-angle clamp, and fine vascular scissors.

after_resolution.text: 我分别保留两端的暴露，夹闭器械进入时不会遮住另一侧。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll preserve exposure at both ends so clamps do not obscure the opposite side.

after_resolution.text: 开始进入大血管操作窗口，失血与循环趋势会即时跟进。
after_resolution.text_en: We're approaching major-vessel work. I'll track blood loss and hemodynamic trends in real time.

before_action.text: 夹闭前需要对上远端灌注、体温和脊髓保护计划，我逐项复述。
before_action.text_en: Before cross-clamping, let's read back distal perfusion, temperature, and spinal-cord protection plans.

before_action.text: 关键肋间动脉的预计位置也列入保护清单，之后不能只顾吻合速度。
before_action.text_en: Include the expected key intercostal arteries in the protection checklist; anastomotic speed is not the only priority.

after_resolution.text: 采用刚确定的灌注与夹闭顺序，每次转换都要获得麻醉侧回应。
after_resolution.text_en: We'll use the chosen perfusion and clamping sequence. Every transition requires an anesthesia response.

after_resolution.text: 灌注相关管路和备用接头已按团队确认清单准备。
after_resolution.text_en: Perfusion tubing and backup connectors are prepared according to the team's checklist.

before_action.text: 近远端控制区都在眼前，夹具进入时我负责保持外侧空间。
before_action.text_en: Both control zones are visible. I'll maintain lateral space as the clamps enter.

before_action.text: 大血管无损夹、血管环和备用夹已排好。
before_action.text_en: Atraumatic aortic clamps, vessel loops, and backup clamps are arranged.

before_action.text: 夹闭动作请逐步报出，我会把远端灌注反应和当前压力趋势对应起来。
before_action.text_en: Call out each clamping step so I can correlate distal perfusion responses with current pressure trends.

after_resolution.text: 夹闭状态与远端支持需要对应核对，我正在复查灌注和压力趋势。
after_resolution.text_en: Clamping and distal support must be assessed together. I'm reviewing perfusion and pressure trends.

after_resolution.text: 控制区就位后先确认瘤段边界，后续切除别牵动夹闭点。
after_resolution.text_en: With control established, confirm the aneurysmal segment boundaries. Do not pull on the clamp sites during resection.

before_action.text: 准备处理的是胸段降主动脉病变，不进入腹段分支重建范围。
before_action.text_en: We're treating the descending thoracic segment, not undertaking abdominal branch reconstruction.

before_action.text: 人工血管本体、规格卡和修剪器械已经独立摆放。
before_action.text_en: The prosthetic graft, size card, and trimming tools are laid out separately.

after_resolution.text: 我维持两端血管对位，让下一步近端吻合有不扭曲的进针方向。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll maintain alignment of both aortic ends for an untwisted proximal anastomosis.

before_action.text: 近端血管壁的厚薄不均，先规划针距，避免缝线把边缘割裂。
before_action.text_en: The proximal aortic wall is uneven in thickness. Plan suture spacing to avoid cutting through the edge.

before_action.text: 大血管缝线、无创血管镊和长持针器。
before_action.text_en: Aortic sutures, atraumatic vascular forceps, and a long needle holder.

after_resolution.text: 近端吻合完成后我守住缝合线，调整移植物方向时不会拿它受力。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll protect the proximal suture line so it does not bear force while the graft is aligned.

after_resolution.text: 大血管吻合阶段继续监测失血和灌注，有变化会即时通报。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll continue monitoring blood loss and perfusion during aortic reconstruction and report changes promptly.

before_action.text: 这组关键肋间动脉与脊髓供血有关，先辨认开口和可重接的组织边缘。
before_action.text_en: These key intercostal arteries contribute to spinal-cord perfusion. Identify their ostia and reimplantable tissue margins.

before_action.text: 细血管剪、小血管钳和补片吻合缝线。
before_action.text_en: Fine vascular scissors, small vascular clamps, and patch-anastomosis sutures.

before_action.text: 我先把这组开口与人工血管的预定窗口对齐，避免补片缝好后受扭。
before_action.text_en: I'll align these ostia with the planned graft window so the patch is not twisted after suturing.

after_resolution.text: 重接区域先保护好，下面调整人工血管时别让这处开口受扭。
after_resolution.text_en: Protect the reimplantation site. Do not twist this opening when positioning the graft.

after_resolution.text: 脊髓保护相关监测会继续结合远端灌注一起判断。
after_resolution.text_en: Spinal-cord protection monitoring will continue alongside assessment of distal perfusion.

before_action.text: 远端连接要顺着主动脉自然走向，先确认长度，别留下折角。
before_action.text_en: The distal connection must follow the aorta's natural course. Check graft length to avoid a kink.

before_action.text: 远端吻合用血管缝线和无损镊，备用止血针线也在手边。
before_action.text_en: Distal vascular sutures and atraumatic forceps are ready, with backup hemostatic sutures nearby.

after_resolution.text: 两端吻合之间的移植物走向再确认，肋间动脉重接部也要一起检查。
after_resolution.text_en: Recheck graft alignment between the two anastomoses, including the intercostal reimplantation site.

after_resolution.text: 备用吸引与冲洗供应已补充，复灌阶段的耗材准备完成。
after_resolution.text_en: Backup suction and irrigation are replenished. Supplies for reperfusion are ready.

before_action.text: 准备分阶段恢复血流，夹闭调整每一步请清楚报出。
before_action.text_en: We're preparing staged reperfusion. Please announce each clamp adjustment clearly.

before_action.text: 我先看近端吻合，再看远端和肋间重接区，不能同时只盯一个出血点。
before_action.text_en: I'll assess the proximal line, then distal and intercostal sites. We cannot watch only one bleeding point.

after_resolution.text: 复灌后的吻合区已经进入复查阶段，我继续保留深面吸引和暴露。
after_resolution.text_en: The reperfused anastomoses are under review. I'll maintain deep suction and exposure.

after_resolution.text: 再灌注后的循环与灌注趋势正在核对，需要调整会立即通知。
after_resolution.text_en: I'm checking hemodynamic and perfusion trends after reperfusion and will report any needed adjustments.

before_action.text: 远端通路、重接的肋间动脉和吻合线止血，按顺序一项项过。
before_action.text_en: Review distal flow, reimplanted intercostal arteries, and anastomotic hemostasis one by one.

before_action.text: 脊髓保护不能只看一项结果，我会合并当前监测与循环信息报告。
before_action.text_en: Spinal-cord protection cannot rely on one measure. I'll report combined monitoring and hemodynamic findings.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的最终复核路径完成确认，再安排引流与关胸。
after_resolution.text_en: Complete confirmation along the selected final review path before drains and closure.

after_resolution.text: 人工血管与血管缝线的实用记录已核对，准备进入终末清点。
after_resolution.text_en: The graft and vascular suture use records are checked. Preparing final counts.

before_action.text: 胸腔引流要避开人工血管和吻合线，我维持最后的深部视野。
before_action.text_en: Chest drains must clear the graft and suture lines. I'll maintain the final deep view.

before_action.text: 胸管固定线、肋间关闭线和皮下器械已换好。
before_action.text_en: Chest-tube fixation sutures, intercostal closure sutures, and subcutaneous instruments are ready.

after_resolution.text: 纱布、针和器械的终末清点完成，移植物识别信息随交接记录移交。
after_resolution.text_en: Final sponge, needle, and instrument counts are complete. Graft identifiers accompany the handoff.

after_resolution.text: 复苏团队会收到远端灌注与脊髓保护的观察重点，继续围术期监测。
after_resolution.text_en: The recovery team will receive priorities for distal perfusion and spinal-cord surveillance as monitoring continues.
